Legacy kern table (TrueType kerning), ported from harfrust aat/kern.rs at static-font scope.

Supports format 0 pair kerning in both the MS (table version 0) and Apple (table version 1) layouts. State-machine (format 1), class-based (formats 2/3), cross-stream, and tuple-variation subtables are skipped with TODO. Wide (24-bit) formats are deferred.
